problems.title: Conjunction distributes over disjunction
problems.statement: (p q r : Prop) : p ∧ (q ∨ r) ↔ (p ∧ q) ∨ (p ∧ r)
problems.reference_proof:
constructor
· intro ⟨hp, h⟩
  cases h with
  | inl hq => exact Or.inl ⟨hp, hq⟩
  | inr hr => exact Or.inr ⟨hp, hr⟩
· intro h
  cases h with
  | inl hpq => exact ⟨hpq.1, Or.inl hpq.2⟩
  | inr hpr => exact ⟨hpr.1, Or.inr hpr.2⟩

problems.title: Equivalence transports negation
problems.reference_proof:
intro h
constructor
· intro hnp hq
  exact hnp (h.mpr hq)
· intro hnq hp
  exact hnq (h.mp hp)

problems.title: Existential distributes over a fixed conjunct
problems.statement: (α : Type) (p : α → Prop) (q : Prop) : (∃ x, p x ∧ q) ↔ (∃ x, p x) ∧ q
problems.reference_proof:
constructor
· intro ⟨x, hpx, hq⟩
  exact ⟨⟨x, hpx⟩, hq⟩
· intro ⟨⟨x, hpx⟩, hq⟩
  exact ⟨x, hpx, hq⟩

problems.title: Pointwise implications compose
problems.statement: (α : Type) (p q r : α → Prop) : (∀ x, p x → q x) → (∀ x, q x → r x) → ∀ x, p x → r x
problems.reference_proof:
intro hpq hqr x hpx
exact hqr x (hpq x hpx)

problems.title: Swap successors on either side of a sum
problems.statement: (a b : Nat) : Nat.succ a + b = a + Nat.succ b

problems.title: Multiply a sum by a natural number
problems.statement: (a b c : Nat) : a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
problems.reference_proof:
induction c with
| zero => simp
| succ c ih =>
  rw [Nat.add_succ, Nat.mul_succ, ih, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc]

problems.title: Cancel the same summand on the right
problems.statement: (a b c : Nat) : a + c = b + c → a = b
problems.reference_proof:
intro h
induction c with
| zero => simpa using h
| succ c ih =>
  apply ih
  rw [Nat.add_succ, Nat.add_succ] at h
  exact Nat.succ.inj h

problems.title: List append is associative
problems.statement: (α : Type) (xs ys zs : List α) : (xs ++ ys) ++ zs = xs ++ (ys ++ zs)
problems.reference_proof:
induction xs with
| nil => rfl
| cons x xs ih => simp [List.append, ih]

problems.title: Mapping distributes over append
problems.statement: (α β : Type) (f : α → β) (xs ys : List α) : (xs ++ ys).map f = xs.map f ++ ys.map f
problems.reference_proof:
induction xs with
| nil => rfl
| cons x xs ih => simp [List.append, List.map, ih]

problems.title: Reversing append swaps its operands
problems.statement: (α : Type) (xs ys : List α) : (xs ++ ys).reverse = ys.reverse ++ xs.reverse
problems.reference_proof:
induction xs with
| nil => simp
| cons x xs ih => simp [List.reverse_cons, ih, List.append_assoc]

problems.title: Reversing a list preserves length
problems.reference_proof:
induction xs with
| nil => rfl
| cons x xs ih => simp [List.reverse_cons, List.length_append, ih]

problems.title: Exclusive or is associative
problems.statement: (a b c : Bool) : (xor (xor a b) c) = xor a (xor b c)
problems.reference_proof: cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> rfl
